analysis:
Examined CHANGELOG.md head lines 2633–3156 against the canonical index and supplied T-041 detail. These units are unchanged historical release notes: the complete range map confines this PR's edits to head lines 11–39. Historical descriptions of model qualification, media bounds/cancellation, cache scope and checkpoint identity, reasoning exposure/billing, tool validation, memory accounting and authorization challenge dispatch therefore do not establish new regressions. In particular, the resident Nemotron prefix bank (2745–2759) differs from T-041's SSD-only description, but is outside this PR's changed ranges and is not reported as a new issue.
The bounded patch introduces account waitlists for new sandbox installation and coordinator-connected cluster setup, while preserving local/offline pairs and existing setups. It also begins describing compatibility when the coordinator lacks waitlists, but that sentence is truncated. Integration must examine the changed CLI/coordinator contracts: distinguish an explicit unsupported-service response from network/authentication failures, verify account-bound approval before new setup side effects, and verify how existing setups are recognized. These affect TB-013/T-061 and serving authorization boundaries TB-002/TB-011; waitlist eligibility must not be mistaken for attestation or serving permission. No implementation or complete fallback policy is supplied here, so no missing enforcement is established. This documentation-only source scope cannot resolve those material PR questions.
